retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast flash photograph of a three-person group in front of a vehicle at night, featuring stacked, wide-tracked geometric typography centered in the upper third.
excludeWhen: minimalist or monochromatic color schemes are requested
hand-drawn or script typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, direct-flash photograph of three men wearing vibrant red and black streetwear, positioned in front of a white vehicle with a blue emergency light bar. The composition is anchored by a centered, three-line block of white, wide-tracked sans-serif text over the dark windshield area.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast flash lighting against a dark night background
Repetition of red tones in clothing against the neutral white of the car
Symmetrical arrangement of the trio with the central figure leaning forward
Stacked typography aligned to the horizontal axis of the car's light bar
coreInvariants: Direct on-camera flash creating harsh shadows
Vibrant red as the primary clothing color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame in a triangular formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the stacked white text above him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright white text down to the central figure, then outward to the flanking members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, underexposed areas at the top and sides emphasize the subjects and the car.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; high value contrast between the white text and dark background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide tracking (letter spacing) to fill the horizontal width

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the dark windshield area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using different tracking or weights for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment with the car's roofline

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric shapes and sharp points match the 90s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and modern geometric feel.
Perfect for the wide, circular geometric look of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flash photograph of three men in red and black 90s streetwear sitting on the hood of a white car at night. The car has a blue light bar on top. The lighting should be harsh and direct.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered, all-caps white text in a bold geometric sans-serif font. Apply extreme letter spacing so the text spans the width of the windshield area.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and stacked in three lines?
Is the tracking wide enough to create a horizontal block?
Does the lighting look like a direct camera flash?
Are the primary colors red, white, and black?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue light bar glow
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on hats or shirts
Identifiable faces of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Flash shadows are visible behind the subjects
The red clothing is highly saturated
The text is legible against the dark background
The composition maintains a triangular subject arrangement
recipe.reuseFormula: Flash-lit group portrait + Vibrant Red/Black palette + Stacked Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans-Serif = 90s Euro-Pop Aesthetic
